# tools — Encoding and hashing

[All groups](README.md)

## tools encode

Encode input every way identity protocols use: base64, base64url (unpadded, as in JOSE), hex, URL query escaping, and DEFLATE+base64 (SAML HTTP-Redirect).

MCP tool: `tools_encode`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--input` | string | Input (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--from` | string | How the input is given. Default `text`. One of `text`, `hex`, `base64`, `base64url`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## tools decode

Work out what an opaque string is and decode it: URL escaping, base64 or base64url, hex, and DEFLATE (SAML Redirect) are tried in turn; JWTs, JWEs, SD-JWTs and SAML messages are recognised and pointed to the right command.

MCP tool: `tools_decode`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--input` | string | The string to decode (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## tools hash

Hash input with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2 (224/256/384/512/512-256) or SHA-3 (256/384/512), or compute an HMAC with a key; results in hex, base64 and base64url. Also the left-half hash used for at_hash/c_hash.

MCP tool: `tools_hash`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--input` | string | Input (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--from` | string | How the input is given. Default `text`. One of `text`, `hex`, `base64`, `base64url`. |
| `--algorithms` | list | md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512, sha512-256, sha3-256, sha3-384, sha3-512. Default `sha256`. |
| `--hmac-key` | string | Key for an HMAC instead of a plain hash (prefer env IDPDBG_HMAC_KEY). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_HMAC_KEY`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
